**STEP 1 - Scene:** A breakfast or lunch tray with a fruit cup, two cold wrap sandwiches (tortilla with lettuce, shredded carrot, meat and cheese), and a glass of orange juice.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The wraps sit on a side plate of about 20 cm diameter (area ≈ 314 cm²). The fruit is in a cereal-sized bowl of about 15 cm (area ≈ 177 cm²). The juice glass is separate but part of the meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:** Two wraps (tortilla, sliced deli meat, cheese, shredded lettuce and carrot); fruit cup (watermelon, cantaloupe, green grapes, blueberry, orange pieces); orange juice.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Wraps cover about 38% of the plate (two cylinders, about 12 × 5 cm each, ≈ 120 cm²). Fruit covers about 60% of the bowl (≈ 106 cm²).

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Wraps: ≈ 120 cm² × 4 cm ≈ 480 ml envelope. Fruit: ≈ 106 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 318 ml. Juice: ≈ 200 ml.

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Wraps at mixed density ~0.5 ≈ 240 g. Fruit at ~0.6 ≈ 190 g, trimmed to about 170 g. Juice ≈ 200 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Tortilla 110 g × 290 kcal/100 g ≈ 319 kcal. Meat 50 g × 110 ≈ 55 kcal. Cheese 40 g × 350 ≈ 140 kcal. Lettuce and carrot 40 g × 20 ≈ 8 kcal. Fruit ≈ 72 kcal. Juice 200 g × 45 ≈ 90 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 610 g and about 680 kcal is plausible for two wraps, a fruit cup and a glass of juice. The wrap estimate is the most uncertain part.
